task.title: Publishing adoptable animals to your website
task.shortdesc: Show your available animals on your own website, and let adopters apply online.

context.p: hosts a listing page for your shelter automatically. You can link to it, embed it in your website, or build your own page with the .

step.cmd: Open SettingsPublic listings and turn on Publish listings.
Choose which species and statuses to publish, and upload your shelter's logo.
Click Get embed code and copy the snippet.
Paste the snippet into your website where the listings should appear.

result.p: Your listings update automatically when an animal's status, photos or description change.
